title: Daily Source Pass
summary: Today's issue is built from Metro Council, Metro Parks, Nashville Public Library, Basement East, Eastside Bowl, Eastpoint public pages/listings, Nashville Guru, City Now Next, and a private-platform hold. The lead package is public-source only.

stages.name: Public Civic Scan
stages.goal: Find same-day official meetings with local stakes.
stages.output: Found Metro Council Budget and Finance Work Session 2 at 4:30 p.m. and the Emergency Preparedness Working Group at 12:30 p.m.

stages.name: Development Watch
stages.goal: Update East Bank/Eastpoint timing from public sources.
stages.output: Found public kickoff listings for Eastpoint at 501 S 2nd Street on May 30 plus reported development context pointing to a May 28 formal groundbreaking.

stages.name: Event And Utility Scan
stages.output: Pulled East Branch Library, Shelby Bottoms, Basement East, and Eastside Bowl public listings for today's useful calendar.

stages.name: Private Platform Gate
stages.goal: Keep community capture out unless supervised notes exist.
stages.output: No new Facebook or Nextdoor material was promoted. Private-platform items stay held until visible supervised capture is available.

stages.name: Publish Pack
stages.goal: Ship source-backed web stories and newsletter-ready copy.
stages.output: Five May 27 stories are ready with source trails, labels, social cuts, and generated covers pending better exact media.
